Here are the requested bullet points:
Dataset Purpose**: The Household Social Consumption: Health dataset is designed to collect information on health-related expenditures and outcomes at the household level in India.
Geographic Coverage**: The dataset covers all states and union territories (UTs) of India, with data collected from 11 blocks across 7 data files.
Population Coverage**: The dataset aims to represent the population of India, with a focus on household-level information on health-related expenditures and outcomes.
+ Proportion of persons reporting an ailment (PPRA)
+ Average medical expenditure per hospitalization case
+ Average out-of-pocket medical expenditure per hospitalization case
+ Average medical expenditure per childbirth case
Sample Size / Scope**: The dataset is based on a survey conducted across 11 blocks, with a total of 7 data files containing unit-level information.
+ Weights are provided for each record to enable estimation of population parameters.
+ Data files are in text format and require aggregation using weights for generating estimates.
